title: Contractor pairs tied on contract notices: do they share a registered address?
question: For differently named contractors that give the same telephone, email domain, suite or officers on City contract notices, does the business registry place them at one address too?
finding: 25 of the 34 notice pairs could be found in the registry under both names; 12 share a registered street address. Pairs tied on the notices by officers' names alone find no shared registry address, so they stay unconfirmed.
how: Each name in the places lane's contract-notice pairs is looked up in the registry (exact name, apostrophe-s folded); every location of the matching accounts is compared, by street and by suite. The number of accounts ever registered at a shared street shows whether it is a multi-tenant building.
limits: The registry does not name officers or owners. A shared building is common for a landlord and its tenant, a charity and its project company, or neighbours in one office tower.
